answer: Sybil resistance derives from an exponential temporal half-life for reputation: only sustained, validated honest service maintains score, while inactivity or deception rapidly erodes it. Under EigenTrust matrix factorization, a freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because peers provide no reciprocal trust. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity and decay deny consensus influence to colluding accounts, whether around a harbor, pearl, or haven, so they cannot pass consensus.
